release_blocker_model.title: Findings, waivers, conditions, commitments, and release-blocker disposition
release_blocker_model.statement: The integrated disposition model for every finding, gap, exception, waiver, condition, compensating control, material commitment, deferred obligation, release blocker, expired condition, and reopened finding, with allowed final dispositions and fail-closed treatment of expired conditions and unresolved blockers.
release_blocker_model.prohibited_inference: Waiver approved is not failed result converted to pass, and no active unresolved item may point to a completed Volume 12 gate.

release_blocker_requirements.title: Release-blocker disposition requirement
release_blocker_requirements.statement: The requirement that every finding, condition, waiver, and unresolved obligation carry a governed disposition and that expired conditions and unresolved release blockers fail closed.
release_blocker_requirements.prohibited_inference: Waiver approved is not failed result converted to pass.

material_commitment_evidence_requirement.title: Material commitment evidence requirement
material_commitment_evidence_requirement.statement: The requirement that every material commitment and deferred obligation carry required evidence, an owner, an effective period, and a revalidation condition before it can be relied upon at any gate.
material_commitment_evidence_requirement.prohibited_inference: Commitment recorded is not commitment discharged.
